sentences.text: It is submitted that pursuant to the investigation the charge-sheet in the matter was filed on 28.11.2021.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was not aware of the FIR and therefore, he could not appear before the IO.
The petitioner became aware about the instant case only upon being received of the summons from the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barpeta.

It is submitted that after the summons being received, the petitioner wanted to appear before the competent Court but he is apprehensive of the fact that if he appears before the Court, he will be taken into custody.

Upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties, this petition is disposed of by directing the petitioner to appear before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barpeta on the date fixed by the Court i.e.
05.08.2023 before whom the charge- sheet has been filed and thereafter, the Court will consider the case of the petitioner on merit and pass appropriate orders by taking note of the law laid down by the Apex Court in Siddharth Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Anr , reported in (2022) 1 SCC 676 and Judgment dated 20.03.2023 rendered in Mahdoom Bava Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation in Criminal Appeal No....... of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Crl) No. 376 of 2023), as it is no longer res integra that appearance of the accused persons pursuant to summons being issued are not required to be taken into custody as a matter of course in all cases.
